about: Ancestries: peoples whose members take classes. attributes add to rolled scores; classes are the callings a member may take; traits are given at birth (Orsino gives every player character humanoid and its ancestry's racial traits); forbiddenTraits are specializations the ancestry may not take.

human.name: Human
human.description: A human of the settled riverlands.

source.notes: Orsino racialModifier attributes, occupation options and forbidden traits; its racial traits and humanoid are given at birth, as in the pc template. Kyr adds the commoner, which is open to every ancestry.
